"""
逆向还原：_tauri_app/commands/utils/tiny_unet.py
================================================
来源：从 _tauri_app.cp311-win_amd64.pyd 提取的符号 + docstring + 日志/异常消息字符串
      （证据见 evidence/pyd_strings.txt）
可靠性：函数名/类名/日志叙事 100% 确证；函数体（数值逻辑）不可读。

本文件是 RONDON 训练循环的核心。以下是还原出的函数/类结构与运行时叙事。
（注意：这是"还原清单"不是"可运行源码"——函数体已编译为机器码）
"""

# ============================================================
# 顶层函数（Tauri 命令 + 训练入口）
# ============================================================

def train_decoder(decoder_id, ...):
    """Tauri 命令 TRAIN_DECODER。创建训练任务并入队。
    日志：
      "train_decoder failed: decoder_id is None"
      "create_train_decoder_task failed: "
    内部嵌套：
      _train_decoder_handler   # 真正的处理器
      call_back                # 回调前端进度
    """
    ...

def _train_decoder_handler(...):
    """训练主循环处理器。嵌套：
      _log_call_back           # 日志回调
      validation_call_back     # 验证回调
    """
    ...

def collect_train_decoder_related_ids(...):
    """收集训练所需的 sample/encoder/decoder id。
    日志："Failed to collect train decoder related ids: "
    """
    ...

def run_training_step_for_decoder(...):
    """训练步。嵌套：
      train_step   # 单步训练（forward+loss+backward+step）
      scheduler    # 学习率调度（cosine_lr）
    日志：
      "Training: "
      " at step "
      " batches"
      " samples missed"
      "Failed to process sample "
      " has no valid training data"
    """
    ...

def run_validation_step_for_decoder(...):
    """验证步。嵌套：
      valid_step
    日志：
      "Validation: "
      ": validation time cost "
      " has no valid validation data"
    """
    ...

def run_evaluation_step_for_decoder(...):
    """评估步（训练后）。嵌套：
      evaluation_step
    日志：
      "Evaluation: "
      " has no valid evaluation data"
    """
    ...

def run_decoder(...):
    """解码器推理。嵌套：
      step   # 单 slice 推理
    命令：RUN_DECODER
    """
    ...

def run_decoder_handler(...):
    """推理处理器（被 auto_seg 复用）。"""
    ...

def save_best_validation_network_parameters(...):
    """保存最优验证权重到 model.safetensors。
    日志："Save best validation network parameters at epoch "
    """
    ...

def save_best_validation_sample_predit_as_decoder_mesh(...):
    """把最优验证样本的预测导出为 3D 网格（tiny_mesh.glb）。"""
    ...

def is_best_dice(...):
    """判断当前 dice 是否为历史最优。"""
    ...

def split_into_batches(...):
    """把 sample_pairs 按 batch_size 分块。"""
    ...

def auto_seg(...):
    """批量自动分割。嵌套：
      _on_success
      _run_decoder_handler
      call_back
    """
    ...


# ============================================================
# 运行时叙事（从日志字符串还原的训练流程）
# ============================================================
#
#   train_decoder
#     → create_train_decoder_task
#     → add_task (任务队列: _run_task, _start_next_from_queue,
#                 _count_running, _count_running_by_category, _has_running)
#     → _train_decoder_handler
#          ├─ collect_train_decoder_related_ids
#          ├─ "Number of training samples: " + N
#          ├─ "Run training on device " + device_id
#          ├─ "Shuffled " + N + " training samples into " + M + " batches"
#          ├─ for epoch in range(epochs):
#          │      "Epoch " + n
#          │      "Training: "    → run_training_step_for_decoder (train_step + scheduler)
#          │      "Validation: "  → run_validation_step_for_decoder (valid_step)
#          │      if is_best_dice:
#          │          "Save best validation network parameters at epoch " + n
#          │      _log_call_back / validation_call_back   # 回调前端
#          └─ "Training run finished"
#
# 训练超参（来自 model.json optimization 字段，确证）：
#   lr=0.0005, epochs=30, batch_size=4, optimizer=Adam, b1=0.9, b2=0.999,
#   eps=1e-8, weight_decay=1e-4, loss=CrossEntropyLoss, validation_interval=2
# 调度器：cosine_lr(base_lr, max_steps, min_lr)   # min_lr 值不可读
# 优化器：tinygrad.nn.optim.Adam / AdamW
# 权重IO：tinygrad.nn.state (safetensors)
# 设备：tinygrad Device（"Run training on device " + device_id，实测默认 CPU）

# ============================================================
# 不可读部分（机器码立即数，无法从字符串还原）
# ============================================================
# - train_step 的具体语句（forward/loss/backward 顺序）
# - cosine_lr 的 min_lr 具体值
# - loss 的加权方式（CE 是否对翻转增强求平均）
# - 翻转 TTA 的精确组合（训练增强 vs 评估 TTA，倾向两者都用）
